# haarcascade_frontalface_alt2.xml

OpenCV's frontal face detector (Rainer Lienhart's tree-based 20x20 gentle AdaBoost cascade), copied unchanged from the Logitech hackathon
repository (`cv/logi-cv-toolbox/FacialLandmarkDetection/`, https://github.com/Logitech/hackathons). The licence (Intel License Agreement
For Open Source Computer Vision Library, BSD-style) is in the header of the file and must stay there.
Used by `brain/src/brain/monitors/behind_monitor.py` because the pip `opencv-python` package ships no model files.
